script.title: AT THE HAIR SALON
script.scene_zh: 髮廊 · 跟設計師確認剪法
script.story_hook: A guy brings a photo, but keeps the length.
script.intro_zh: 一個男生拿著照片，卻想保留自己的長度。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, good-looking people! Today we're getting the right haircut.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，愛帥氣的各位！今天我們要剪一個剛剛好的頭髮。
script.outro: Layers checked, bangs saved, curls bounced. Fresh hair, fresh day.
script.outro_zh: 層次確認、瀏海留白、捲度彈起。新頭髮，新的一天。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat this salon chat line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來逐句跟讀這段髮廊對話。
script.char_a_description: a slim man in his early thirties with shoulder-length light brown wavy hair and a short beard, wearing a black hoodie with a small tear near the cuff, nervously holding up his phone
script.char_b_description: a stylish woman in her late twenties with an asymmetrical platinum blonde bob and a small lip stud, wearing a paint-splashed black apron over a mesh top, scissors glinting in her hand
script.youtube_title: 【💇✂️剪髮溝通英文】「長度保留，可以嗎？」拿照片跟設計師確認層次與瀏海｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜Haircut English
script.youtube_title_en: “Keep the Length, If Possible” — Getting the Right Haircut
script.youtube_description:
拿照片給設計師，卻不知怎麼補充要求？這段髮廊對話教你說保留長度、不要電剪、確認瀏海，把想要的頭髮講得一清二楚。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Have a photo but no words for what you actually want? This salon conversation covers keeping the length, skipping the clippers, and saying no to bangs. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA translations, plus a full listen-and-repeat section so the phrases stay with you.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💇剪髮英文｜照片說明・保留長度・瀏海確認｜聽完就會下要求的句子｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
給了設計師一張照片，可你要的其實不太一樣？
層次、長度、瀏海，到底該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進一間活潑的髮廊，跟著一位卷髮男生從拿出參考照片、確認只短一吋、不用電剪，到堅決不剪瀏海，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📱 給設計師看照片：例如「I brought a photo.」、「Ooh, that's a lot of layers.」。
✂️ 說明修剪條件：例如「keep the length, if possible」、「just tidy, no clippers this time.」。
🙅 拒絕瀏海：例如「Bangs, or keep the forehead free?」、「I can't style those at all.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次坐進髮廊，終於能說出自己的要求！
script.thumbnail_action: showing a haircut photo on a phone

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Rosa, good to see you again.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈroʊzə ɡʊd tə si ju əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨 Rosa，很高興又見到你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Same thing as last time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu seɪm θɪŋ æz læst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我也高興！跟上次一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually no, I brought a photo.
dialogue.zh: 其實不然，我帶了一張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh nice. Ooh, that's a lot of layers.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs u ðæts ə lɑt əv ˈleɪərz/
dialogue.zh: 喔不錯。哇，這層次剪得很開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, but keep the length, if possible.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ bət kip ðə lɛŋθ ɪf ˈpɑsəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，但如果可以，請保留長度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, with your curls it'll lift a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wɪð jɜr kɜrlz ɪl lɪft ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，以你的捲髮來說，會看起來短一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, how much shorter will it look?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm haʊ mʌtʃ ˈʃɔrtər wɪl ɪt lʊk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe an inch, honestly. Not a big jump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ən ɪntʃ ˈɑnəstli nɑt ə bɪɡ dʒʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，大概一吋。差別不大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can live with that, sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool. And what about the sides?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, just tidy, no clippers this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl dʒʌst ˈtaɪdi noʊ ˈklɪpərz ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，只要整理一下，這次不要用電剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Bangs, or keep the forehead free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt bæŋz ɔr kip ði ˈfɔrˌhɛd fri/
dialogue.zh: 了解。要瀏海，還是把額頭露出來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No bangs! I can't style those at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bæŋz aɪ kænt staɪl ðoz ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 不要瀏海！我完全不會整理那東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fair enough. Layers, one inch, no bangs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛr ɪˈnʌf ˈleɪərz wʌn ɪntʃ noʊ bæŋz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，很合理。層次、剪短一吋、不剪瀏海。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds exactly right. Let's do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ɪɡˈzæktli raɪt lets du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完全就是我要的。就這麼辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, wash first, then we start cutting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wɑʃ fɜrst ðɛn wi stɑrt ˈkʌtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，先洗頭，然後我們開始剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good. I trust your hands completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd aɪ trʌst jɔr hændz kəmˈplitli/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯。我完全信任你的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks! You'll love how it bounces.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！你會愛上那個彈起來的感覺。
